description: This file declares the StateObserver class, which implements the IStateObserver interface. It manages session server states associated with application IDs, providing methods to handle state changes, retrieve current states, and get the active application. It uses mutexes for thread safety and includes standard C++ containers.

classes.name: StateObserver
classes.description: Implements the IStateObserver interface to monitor and manage session server states, ensuring thread safety with mutexes.

methods.name: stateChanged
methods.description: Handles updates to the session server state for a given application ID.

methods.name: getCurrentState
methods.description: Returns the current session server state for a specified application ID.

methods.name: getActiveApp
methods.description: Returns the application ID of the currently active application.
